title: GOV-0033: badf-research has no deep-research acquisition subskill (P0 5/9; source-receipt prerequisite for control 6)
problem:
## Observed
`badf-research` has 4 of 9 P0 subskills; `deep-research` — the external source-acquisition plane — does not exist. It is the prerequisite the operator named for control 6 (source-digest freshness): freshness can only be enforced once acquisition owns the source receipt.

## Expected
Build `deep-research` as P0 subskill **5 of 9**: a concise `SKILL.md` for **read-only** external acquisition — query decomposition, primary/authoritative-source preference, independent corroboration, provenance capture (the source receipt: uri, source_type, retrieved_at, content digest, and where they exist a resolved revision + retrieval outcome), and contradiction preservation. It does not decide, authorise, or choose an implementation. Register `IMPLEMENTED`.

**No new gate control in this WP** — its enforcement teeth are control 6 (the next WP), which adds the receipt fields and staleness semantics. Per the discipline "no control merely because prior subskills had one", deep-research earns none.

## Evidence
- `ls skills/badf-research/subskills` → `repository-research`, `problem-framing`, `fact-checking`, `evidence-synthesis` (no `deep-research`)
- source schema today: `uri, source_type, retrieved_at, digest` — no resolved-revision or retrieval-outcome receipt fields yet (control 6 adds them)

## Unknowns
None for the SKILL contract. Not in scope: control 6 (next WP), general crawling implementation, the other 4 P0 subskills, #77/#83/#84.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0049`. `deep-research/SKILL.md` + registry entry `IMPLEMENTED`; root router (5/9); registration test; own G07 self-dossier. C2. No new control (documented). `badf-research` stays `DESIGNED` (5 of 9 P0).
